versions.changelog:
Version 1.1.0 introduces expanded docs, improved messaging, and attribution updates.

- Rewrote and clarified usage guidance in SKILL.md, including explicit handling rules and error format explanations.
- Updated author attribution from Zillapi to Zero Point Studio.
- Changed repository links to new org (ZeroPointRepo).
- Improved and expanded error handling documentation for users.
- Removed skill-card.md. Added .pyc cache files.
v1.0.1: parity update with zillow-full. Tightened intent-based activation guidance + declared ZILLAPI_KEY in metadata.openclaw.requires.env.

Initial release of zillow-zestimate skill:

- Provides fast property value estimates via Zillapi.com, including Zestimate, rent Zestimate, tax assessed value, and last sale price.
- Offers a single lightweight tool for value lookups; separate from a full-featured Zillow integration.
- Requires only a Zillapi API key for setup.
- Simple tool interface: use zpid or address to retrieve valuation data.
- Transparent free/paid usage and rate limit details included.
